title: Marryandbride product card
description: A shop tile: a square-cornered 2:3 photo with an optional small black NEW badge at its lower left, then the name in tracked uppercase with the kind of garment at the right in grey, and the price in grey below. On hover a second photo fades in over the first (0.4s ease-out).
notes: empty media shows a bg-muted placeholder; pass an with object-cover to fill it
the garment kind is shown from 1024px only, as on the original
name: marryandbride-product-card

props.name: kind
props.description: the kind of garment, shown at the right from 1024px (e.g. "Cardigan")

props.name: media
props.description: the photo (2:3); empty shows a placeholder

props.name: hoverMedia
props.description: a second photo that fades in on hover
